description: Implicit classmethod called on the parent each time a subclass is created, after `__set_name__` and before class decorators (PEP 487).
A keyword in the class header, such as `name="csv"`; every keyword except `metaclass` is passed to `__init_subclass__` and is not inherited.
Consume your own keywords and forward the rest with `super().__init_subclass__(**kwargs)`, so mixins later in the MRO receive theirs.
A dict on the base class mapping names to classes, filled when each class statement runs, so code can pick a class by name.
A plugin registers only when its module is imported; plugin discovery must import the modules or read entry points.
